name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard
description:
GameFrameX OperationKeyboard — mini-game keyboard channel registry with UI field binding. The core package provides IOperationKeyboardManager (Show / Hide / UpdateValue + input / confirm / complete / height events), IOperationKeyboardField (UI-agnostic field contract), OperationKeyboardRegistry (mutual-exclusion resolution) and the static OperationKeyboard facade with single-slot field arbitration (only one field holds the keyboard at a time; attaching a new field hides the keyboard and detaches the old one). maxLength is always passed as -1 (mini-game keyboards count the pinyin composition string, a hard cap breaks Chinese input). With no channel registered the facade is a no-op and the native TouchScreenKeyboard path is preserved. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard —— 小游戏键盘渠道注册表与 UI 字段绑定功能包。主包提供 IOperationKeyboardManager（Show / Hide / UpdateValue 与输入 / 确认 / 完成 / 高度事件）、IOperationKeyboardField（UI 无关字段契约）、OperationKeyboardRegistry（互斥解析注册表）与带字段会话单槽仲裁的 OperationKeyboard 静态门面（同一时刻仅一个字段持有键盘，新字段 Attach 时自动收起并解绑旧字段）；maxLength 恒传 -1（小游戏键盘按拼音组合串计数，硬上限会掐断中文输入）；未注册渠道时门面 no-op，原生 TouchScreenKeyboard 路径完整保留。
